names.note: Read out of the title on the first of the two name links behind the line for 6 апреля ст. ст., name page 10021, «Петр (Жуков), мч.», with the rank abbreviation left off and the surname kept in the brackets the calendar prints it in. The day’s own line gives the forename alone, «Петра», and eleven folders already share the bare «Петр», so the surname is what keeps this one out of that fold. The life calls him Петр Жуков without the brackets. No folder holds this form; `hilarion-zhukov` is the only other folder whose slug carries the surname and he is a different man.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 апреля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Петра и Прохора (1918).»

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes the two men’s line for 6 апреля ст. ст. with «(1918)», and its life dates the events: the inventory of the church on 27 March 1918, the volost assembly and the arrests in April, and the killing on the road to Вышний Волочек. The page gives no day of the month for the deaths themselves, so the year is written flat and no dual date is constructed.
